action.command:
docker exec open_taki_test python3 -c "
import fitz
doc = fitz.open()
for i in range(2):
    page = doc.new_page()
    page.insert_text((72,72), 'Test PDF page %d. ' % i + 'This is a sample contract text. '*30, fontsize=11)
doc.save('/tmp/test.pdf')
print('created')
" 2>&1 | grep -v deprecated
docker cp open_taki_test:/tmp/test.pdf /tmp/test.pdf
echo "=== PDF extract ==="; curl -s -m 60 -X PUT -H 'Content-Type: application/pdf' --data-binary @/tmp/test.pdf http://localhost:9998/rmeta/text | head -c 500; echo
echo "=== log ==="; docker logs open_taki_test 2>&1 | tail -3
